newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasury studies possible muni bond abuses.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasury studies possible muni bond abuses.

text.p: The Treasury Department is looking into allegations that a loophole in its revised state and local government series (SLGS) program could lead to abuses by municipalities, a senior official said on Wednesday.
"Obviously this is a matter of great concern to us," said Deputy Assistant Treasury Secretary Roger Anderson. "We will study it closely. We will consult with the IRS (Internal Revenue Service)."
Municipal bond participants sent a three-page letter to Treasury on Tuesday warning of abuses that could arise from new Treasury rules governing SLGS.
Asked by reporters if Treasury planned to change its rules, Anderson said, "We haven't had time to evaluate it fully." He added that Treasury did not know of any specific instances of abuse.
